# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten to eleven years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c19 P12](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** The United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Brierley school  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric has a tiny, remarkably beautiful face with refined features, chestnut-colored curly hair, and large, dark blue eyes. His Crimson lips curve into finely crafted corners that almost form dimples, and his face often carries a sober, grave, and meditative expression. He is quite small for his age, though he begins growing taller during his time in Brierley.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 c15 P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 c28 P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009)_

## Personality

Cedric is a thoughtful, sensitive, and imaginative boy who connects deeply with others who share his creative nature. Despite his deep inner world of fantasy, he possesses a solid sense of fairness, polite manners, and natural manliness. He is earnest in his spiritual and personal struggles, often holding deep conversations on serious topics. He carries a quiet maturity and a tender devotion toward his family and loved ones.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c15 P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 c15 P18](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0018), [v2 c19 P12](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0012), [v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)_

## History

Cedric was born in the United States to Stephen Stanhope and his American wife. Following his mother's death, his father sent ten-year-old Cedric to live with his grandmother on the shore road in Brierley. Upon joining the local school, he instantly formed a special friendship with his new teacher, Nell Harcourt, who appreciated his imaginative nature and sensitive spirit. During his time at school, he excelled as a student, defended younger classmates, and befriended Nell through shared stories and gifts of wild flowers. He also developed a close bond with Miss Rosalind Penrose of Echo Cottage. When his father visited Brierley, Cedric helped re-establish the connection between Stephen and Rosalind, leading to their eventual marriage. Following their wedding, plans were made for Cedric to move to Boston with his father and new mother.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 c15 P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P30](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0030), [v2 c23 P35](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0035), [v2 c28 P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023), [v2 c29 P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 c29 P8](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0008)_
